notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a long time since the last update, and I apologise for my lack of communication. I have had much less time to work on the game this year than is needed to get out regular updates. However, I have been working on it slowly but surely. I can't say when the next update will be ready but I thought it would be good to let you know about the progress I have made on it.

I have made some improvements to the gameplay in a small rework of the main mechanics. I go over most of these in the latest dev-log, posted back in August ([url=https://www.squillamorph.com/home/3-years-of-squillamorph]Click here to read it[/url]), but I'll briefly summarise them here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36121374/b1a93de17407cf95f16bb7f6c6aaa6bd2c6aeb99.gif[/img]

[h3]Player[/h3]
The main mechanic of the game, 'Infesting' enemies, was perhaps a little too complex to use. Infesting will no longer require collecting essence or accurate dash aiming. Instead, attacking enemies as the parasite a number of times will infest them. Additionally, the parasite will no longer take damage when colliding with enemies as this felt too punishing. 
Another change is that the parasite will no longer start with the dash mechanic. It will be something that can be unlocked later in the game. This restriction should provide more scenarios requiring enemies to be used, and potentially a few other fun gameplay opportunities.

[h3]World[/h3]
The game world is being restructured. The current levels don't give the impression of the connected world that I want to convey. So I am recreating them to make the game world feel more like a cohesive facility.

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
There are too many situations where I've felt the enemies have been too unwieldy to control precisely in combat. The enemies will be more responsive and snappy with input now. 
I am also removing the time limit on infestation. Enemies can be controlled indefinitely, but will not regenerate their health upon infestation. 


I hope you are excited about the improvements! I am planning more to come in the next update, but I am not ready to discuss this yet. Hopefully, it won't be long before I have more to show. 
Thank you for being patient with me. 

- James

notes.title: Update 0.2.3 - Festive Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are all enjoying the festive season! It's time again for an update to bring a little bit of holiday cheer to Squillamorph! In addition to some festive cosmetics, the game has several needed improvements. Most notably, I have added one of the most requested features, a control mapper. This means you can finally remap controls for both keyboard and controller.
You can see all the changes in the changelog below, I hope you enjoy the festive update! Happy holidays! :D

- James


[h3]Acknowledging Game Issues[/h3]
In addition to the usual changelog, I'd like to take a moment to acknowledge and address some of the issues and bugs that players have been having with the game: 
[list]
[*]First and foremost the controls. Some confusion has been had with the keyboard controls due to an error on my part. I have now fixed this and additionally added a control mapper to the game.
I have also heard that some players are struggling with controller use. I would ask that if you do have issues with controller usage, could you please make a post in the discussion forum so I can fix it. :)

[*]Secondly, the performance issues. I am aware that the game has numerous performance issues, and bugs that result from this. I am doing my best to optimize the game to fix these issues, but this will take time.
I am also aware of some players experiencing consistent crashes. Unfortunately, I am currently unable to reproduce these crashes, but I am doing my best to pinpoint the cause and fix it. (I am hopeful that this update will fix the crashes but no guarantees there.)

[*]Lastly, I would like to address the current quantity of game content. Please bare in mind that this is an Early Access game and content will increase over time. Nonetheless, I have several reasons for the lack of content:
[olist]
[*]Most of the work I am currently doing on the game is background work like optimisation, which does not add more content to the game. 
[*]In my opinion, there is no point in adding more content to a game that players are unable to reliably play/enjoy. I would rather take the quality over quantity stance, until the state of the existing content is more stable and enjoyable.
[*]I do not have time to work on the game full time. For the past few months, I have only had the time to work on it at the weekends. I am no happier about it than any of you are but that is the way it is.
[/olist][/list]
I apologise for these issues but I am doing my best to improve the game. If you ever have an issue with the game, please let me know as it really helps me to improve the game! I would like to thank those who have given me feedback and those who have reviewed the game. I am very appreciative of every review and piece of feedback. Thank you! :D

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Time for another Squillamorph update! This update brings some general improvements and a few new features. I've revamped the tutorial again, which now includes some extra information and should be slightly easier to understand. There's a new visual indicator for the player movement direction, to make using the dash ability easier. You can always disable it in the pause menu settings if you do not like it. The Waste Processors region levels have been mostly decorated and I've added some environmental lights to various levels. There is still more visual work to do on all levels but they are looking better already! All new features and changes are listed below.

In terms of future updates, I have been working on some new levels and enemies. They are not quite ready to play with yet, but I'll make a post about them soon on the [url=https://www.squillamorph.com/]development log[/url].

As always, I'd love to know how you are getting on with the game! You can give me any feedback via the Steam Community discussion page.
I hope you enjoy the update!

- James

notes.title: Squillamorph Update 0.2.0 - Rework
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It is finally time for another Squillamorph update. It has been a long time since the last one, so I thank you for your patience. I apologise for the lack of updates, but working on Squillamorph as much as I used to has become unsustainable for me. Nonetheless, as this update shows, I have not stopped working on it!

This is a big update. I have reworked the core gameplay of Squillamorph. I have several reasons for doing this. My main reason is that the game was starting to feel like too much of a grind. Another large reason is that I want to be able to tell more of a story through the game. I didn't feel that doing so would have worked well with the style of game I was aiming for. This update is the result of my endeavour to improve on the idea of the game. Personally, I find it much more enjoyable to play now. I hope that you do too!

I have had to make some compromises to get this update out sooner: I had to remove the Reactor K levels as I have not yet found the time to update them to work with the new systems. There is also more decorating and polishing to do throughout all the new levels; The Waste Processors levels are mostly unfinished from a visual standpoint. Also, you'll probably notice a lack of sound effects for some of the new features. I will be working to get all this done soon, but there will have to be a balance between making new levels and polishing existing ones.

I understand that some of the changes I have made are quite drastic. So if you have any feedback about the new changes, please let me know as I would love to hear your thoughts! The best way to give me any feedback is through the Steam Community discussion page. Also, I am certain there will be bugs. Let me know if you find one!

I hope you enjoy this update!

- James



[h2]Changes[/h2]

[h3]Control Scheme[/h3]
[list]
[*]Controllers are now the recommended device to play with
[*]Mouse removed from control scheme
[*]Controls on both keyboard and controllers have been rebound
[*]Movement is now locked to eight directions
[*]You can now navigate menus with a controller
[/list]

[h3]New World Design[/h3]
[list]
[*]The planned game world size has increased
[*]The number of levels per area of the game has increased
[*]Levels redesigned
[*]Levels are now interconnected
[*]Player re-spawn points are no longer in every level
[*]Tutorial expanded on by using text based descriptions of mechanics
[/list]

[h3]Player Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Player movement is much more responsive
[*]Mutagen system disabled
[*]Ability unlocks added
[*]Player Dash mechanics & Wall Jump mutagen are now collectable abilities
[*]Score system removed
[*]New health system added
[*]Essence mechanic added
[*]Revamped Heads Up Display to reflect new systems
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Combat improved, more responsive attacks and abilities.
[*]Test Dummy enemy names chnaged to Iterator Sentry & Iterator Guard
[*]New enemy: Iterator Knight
[*]New boss: Lab Sentinel
[*]Flopalodon boss fight updated: the crushers are now triggered by player proximity
[/list]

[h3]Art Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pixel ratio for resolutions with a height of 1080 pixels and above changed to 2:1
[*]Foreground scenery parallax layer added
[*]New tile based scenery assets
[*]New alarms to signal enemy spawning event
[*]New smoother camera movement
[*]Camera shake and freeze frame added for player taking damage
[*]New shadow tile assets over foreground to put more focus on level area
[*]Removed aiming reticle
[/list]

[h3]Misc Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Local leaderboard changed to time based entries as score has been removed
[*]New music system to switch between ambient and combat tracks
[*]New music for Iteration Labs: ambient, combat, and boss music
[*]New music for Waste Processors: ambient
[*]Removed outdated Reactor K levels
[*]Optimisations to enemy pathfinding should make a big increase to performance
[*]Optimisations to saved level pathfinding data has reduced total game size and load times
[/list]

Apologies if I've missed a change or two off the list.

notes.title: Update v0.1.3
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone! The festive season is over and it’s time for another Squillamorph update. This is a smaller update than normal, but it brings a big improvement. I discovered an element of the game that has been causing major performance issues, which I was able to fix with a slight change to the main character's fluid effect. Despite the change, you shouldn’t notice anything major apart from a smoother experience!
I hope you enjoy the update!
- James

If you want to report any issues or bugs, give feedback, share your high scores, or just want to talk about the game, feel free to join the Discord server!

[b]FEATURES: [/b]
[list][*]Infest particle effect
[i]- Added a particle effect to highlight taking control of an enemy.[/i]
[/list]


[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list][*]Removed Santa hats
[/list]


[b]OPTIMISATIONS:[/b]	
[list][*]Metaballs visual effect altered
[i]- To create the fluid effect (metaballs) used for the main character, art assets had to be blurred. The method used to blur the assets was causing performance issues on graphics cards. 
- All art assets that need to be blurred are now pre-blurred.
- The previous blur method has been removed.[/i]
[/list]


[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list][*]Stunned effect duration
[i]- Enemy stun effect now stops at the end of the stun duration.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.1.2 - Christmas Update
notes.content:
Update 0.1.2 – Christmas Update

Hello everyone! The Christmas update is here, and it brings many improvements to the game! Thank you again for the support and feedback. I’ve worked hard to improve the game for this update, based on your feedback. Combat is a big focus for this update, and I’ve done what I can to make it fairer, clearer, and more enjoyable. Of course, I couldn’t resist adding in something for the festive season, and this comes in the form of Santa hats! 

I wish you all a Merry Christmas and I hope you enjoy the update!
- James

If you want to report any issues or bugs, give feedback, or just want to talk about the game, feel free to join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/sN96BpK]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for supporting the game and giving feedback! I’ve now finished working on the first update for the game. I’ve resolved some of the main issues and bugs discovered and reported by the community and I have begun working on optimisations, which should start to improve performance on all quality settings.
I hope you enjoy the updated game!
- James

If you want to report any issues or bugs, give feedback, or just want to talk about the game, feel free to join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/sN96BpK]Discord server[/url]!


[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[b]FEATURE: [/b]
[list][*]Spawn & ejection invincibility
     	[i]- 1.5 seconds of invincibility is now applied after respawning. 
	- 0.4 seconds of invincibility is now applied after ejecting.
	- Represented by a flashing blue colour.	[/i]	
[/list]

[b]UPDATES: [/b]
[list][*]Infest range increased
	[i]- Required distance from enemy ‘infest orb’ to infest the enemy has been increased slightly.[/i]

[*]Door sounds now use 3D space
	[i]- Door sounds now use a 3D spatial blend to allow for stereo placement. Changed to improve the ease of locating unlocking doors. [/i]

[*]Tutorial progress preventer
	[i]- Cannot progress further than the Infest combat tutorial without obtaining 100 points. Added to remove the need to backtrack in the tutorial if players progress without killing an enemy.[/i]
[/list]

[b]OPTIMISATIONS:	[/b]
[list][*]Physics object optimisations	
	[i]- Restructuring of collision checking code to reduce wasteful/unnecessary operations. 
	- Physics objects are now updated by a manager object rather than updating themselves.[/i]

[*]Creature optimisations	
	[i]- Creatures are now updated by a manager object rather than updating themselves. [/i]

[*]Camera optimisations	
	[i]- Camera position calculations are now reduced according to the quality setting.[/i]

[*]Graphics optimisations	
	[i]- Background tiles are now displayed using a single quad mesh instead of individual meshes.[/i]
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES:	[/b]
[list][*]Colour palette inaccuracy	
	[i]- Some GPUs would display objects using colour palette shaders inaccurately.[/i]

[*]Enemies out of bounds	
	[i]- Enemies going out of the pathfinding grid area, caused by inaccuracies during lag or low performance, are now disabled to prevent an error from creating further lag.
[/i]
[*]Steam overlay pausing	
[i]- Opening the Steam overlay while the game is paused will no longer resume the game.[/i]
[/list]
